_about: Every Vimshottari date AstroSage printed for Rohan (Lahiri unless marked KP), transcribed verbatim: 'antar' = the PDF's page-3 maha/antar END dates (d, m, yy); 'blocks' = the docx Rohan supplied on 2026-10-20 (Vimshottari_Dasha_Documentation.docx): section 3 pratyantar END dates under each maha-antar, section 4 sookshma END dates with AstroSage's hour (d, m, yyyy, hour); 'kp' = the PDF's KP-ayanamsa pratyantar pages 44-47 (same arithmetic, a different Moon). Used by tests/test_vimshottari.py to pin WHY AstroSage's antar dates differ from the engine's: a 360-day year of twelve 30-day months (see README > Known deviations). Years in 'antar' and 'kp' are two-digit as printed.
